_readme: An example patch for the admin's Places slipstream page.
Paste this into the box, or attach this file, and the two entries below are
added to Admin/data/places.json. Nothing else in that file is touched.
You do not have to send a whole file like this. A bare list of entries works,
and so does a single entry on its own. Only 'remove' ever deletes anything.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by everything that reads these files, so
notes to yourself are safe to leave in.
CATEGORY decides which section of the directory it joins, and that matters
more than it looks: the phone line treats parks as outdoors and hides them
in the Las Vegas summer. Use one of these:
senior_centers  libraries  parks  indoor_summer  pharmacies  dialysis
physical_therapy  hospice  care_homes  adult_day_and_respite  transport
helplines
A spoken word is understood too - 'pharmacy' becomes 'pharmacies'. An entry
with no category at all lands in indoor_summer, which is the safe default.
GOOD_FOR is what the matching actually runs on. Words worth using, because
the phone agent scores against them: quiet, indoor, shade, no_stairs,
benches, seating, accessible_parking, free_wheelchairs, drive_up_picnic,
cards, classes, fitness, summer_refuge, early_morning.
SOURCE is where you found it. Every researched entry in places.yaml cites
one, and the reason is not tidiness: a wrong address sends a frail person to
the wrong building, and the source is how anyone checks.

add.name: Walnut Recreation Center
add.address: 3075 N. Walnut Rd., Las Vegas, NV 89115
add.notes: Air conditioned all day, which is the whole point of it in July.

add.name: Sunrise Coffee
add.address: 3130 E. Sunset Rd., Las Vegas, NV 89120
add.notes: Big tables, unhurried, nobody minds you sitting for two hours.
